new: Library: a shuffle button on each section (and a Random chip in grid view) opens a random title from it.
Settings › Downloads › Finish a series downloads the rest: flagging Finish this series downloads every remaining episode, lowest first (off: only the Smart downloads count).
improved: Analysis works through each show from the lowest season and episode up.
Downloads: when the picked source isn't cached on debrid (or its link is stale), the next good source is tried automatically.
Only on Wi-Fi and Only while charging are always shown in Settings › Downloads, since they also hold back Finish a series and queued episodes.
Hold menus and sheets wrap long rows onto two lines; the per-show row now reads 'Auto-skip: Default' and Finish a series is shortened.
fixed: The 'isn't fully analysed yet' prompt no longer appears on episodes that are already analysed when only recap/preview data is being refreshed in the background.
Opening the download Live Activity while watching now closes the player first, instead of leaving it playing hidden and reopening it (with different audio/subtitles) when Home was tapped.

improved: A show's skip marks and analysis are shared however you opened it (TMDB or IMDb id); episodes stored under the other id are merged in once.
Your marks and imported submissions remember the video length; they are only used on a version of the episode within 30 s of it.
fixed: Importing your TheIntroDB submissions now finds which ones belong to the show more reliably, and retries on the next play when the list failed instead of waiting for an app restart.
Submissions without a known video length no longer teach intro/credits to the other episodes.
Shared nuvio://skip marks are saved as your marks, not labelled as TheIntroDB submissions.
Two analysis jobs finishing at the same time can no longer overwrite each other's results or a mark you just made.

Imported submissions made on a different length of the episode are no longer shown, applied or labelled as yours there; the 191 clean-up runs once more, and every imported row is logged (Settings › Logs) so a wrong one can be traced.

improved: Skip source labels are honest everywhere: 'TheIntroDB (yours)' / 'Your submission' only for what you submitted for that exact episode, 'Your mark' for marks made on this phone, 'TheIntroDB', 'IntroDB' and 'On-device' for the rest.
fixed: Importing your TheIntroDB submissions could put another show's times on an episode with the same number (shown as 'Your submission' on episodes you never submitted). Only submissions that provably belong to the show are imported now.
Those wrongly imported times are removed once on update; your real submissions are imported again the next time you play the show, and marks made on this phone are kept.

new: Settings › Playback › Playback debug readout: shows the player's live position, duration and the skip segments it is comparing, to pin down wrong skip times.
improved: The mini player is off by default again; turn it on in Settings › Playback.
fixed: Next-episode sources preload again before the end of an episode.
Subtitle sync by ear, the chapters panel, Submit Intro, the mini player progress bar, a server-source retry and switching playback engine use the real playback position instead of 0.
Starting a new analysis or intro-clip check no longer resumes a cancelled one.

new: Brings in the latest Nuvio Enhanced (0.6.2-beta): a mini player on iOS, pinch to zoom and a real Fill mode on the MPV player, and a button to switch a portrait video between portrait and landscape.
Optional Liquid Glass look across Android and an iPad tab bar option, with live values while you drag a settings slider.

Downloaded episodes can find their intro even when no other episode of the season is downloaded: Nuvio listens to just the intro of the nearest episode whose times are known (your own mark first, then TheIntroDB) and finds the same music in your download. It shows as "Intro · Found using E12".
improved: Subtitles: an optional libmpv renderer draws styled ASS/SSA subtitles on the Android player.
Anime: better matching of anime titles across Trakt, Simkl, MDBList and ratings; Brazilian Portuguese is more complete.
No new changes from the main Nuvio project since the last update.
fixed: Simkl: a series you marked as watched moves to Completed.
iOS: external players are still offered when the app can't check which ones are installed.
Watch Party: guests see the shared stream and the episode picker properly, and no wrong "no addons" message.

improved: Home: row titles like "Paused · tap to restore" and "2 for tonight · 1h 30m" use the full width instead of being cut short next to an empty space.
Watch stats: the last-7-days chart shows compact times ("1h30") that fit small phones instead of being cut off.
Detail page: year, runtime, age rating and IMDb score wrap to a second line on small phones instead of squeezing the score; episode dates and ratings do the same.
fixed: Continue Watching: the shuffle and Finish-a-series badges moved to the top-left corner, so they no longer cover long titles or the progress bar.
Screen and settings headers keep their buttons visible next to long or translated titles.
Player: the next-episode card keeps the "Playing via … in 5s" countdown visible, and the submit-times and sync-by-ear panels keep their close button next to long titles.
Streams: tapping a source header opens the pin options (it used to flash and do nothing); headers that can't be pinned no longer react.
Download Season: the 5/10/20/50 GB buttons wrap on small phones instead of the last one being squeezed; long episode details show two lines.
Collections editor, card-depth settings, trailers picker and the seasons header keep their check, icon or arrow visible next to long text.

improved: Downloads: the size line of an active download is short and never cut off ("134 MB / 1.9 GB"); percent, speed and time left are on the line below.
Downloads: a show says "3 episodes · 1 downloading" and its Cancel season button sits under that line instead of squeezing it.
Downloaded episodes list where each skip time comes from on its own short line, like "Intro · Your mark" or "Recap · TheIntroDB".
fixed: Counts read properly everywhere they were wrong: no more "1 downloads", "1 submissions" or "folder(s)" (downloads, storage, Download Season, analysis, collections, TheIntroDB import, Continue Watching settings).
Download storage: the Nuvio / Other / Free sizes wrap to a second line on small phones instead of the last one being cut off.
TheIntroDB submit screen: "Your submissions" and "Copy share link" wrap instead of overflowing.

improved: Updated to Nuvio 0.6.2: chat in Watch Party; on iPhone a party stays in sync in Picture in Picture and the lock-screen controls follow the party rules.
Autoplay of the next episode picks the exact next file from the same release (matching file name, then the same torrent) before any other source.
Greek and Italian translations, plus wording fixes in several other languages. Library sections show proper titles.
Settings > Downloads storage: new "Verify downloads" checks every finished download and re-downloads the damaged ones.
Finished downloads are checked right away. A damaged file is re-downloaded by itself with the message "Damaged, re-downloading".
If a download plays with errors or keeps jumping ahead, the player offers to stream instead and re-downloads the file afterwards.
Download rows show a steady status: size on the first line, percent, speed and time left on the second, with fixed-width digits so nothing jumps while it counts.
Downloads: when TheIntroDB, IntroDB or your own submitted times cover an episode, its analysis tags say so ("Intro/credits from TheIntroDB ✓") instead of "needs another episode".
When Finish a series completes a show, the audio fingerprints kept for matching its episodes are removed; the skip times stay for a rewatch.
fixed: Finish a series never goes back to earlier episodes: it remembers the furthest episode you reached, and at the end of the show it removes the goal ("Finished <show>, goal removed") instead of starting again at S1E1.
Downloads: the "Failed / incomplete downloads" header no longer sits under the top bar.

Resumed downloads could glue on bytes from a different copy of the file, giving noise and jumps during playback. A resume now only continues when the server confirms the exact same file and position; otherwise it starts over.
Skip times from TheIntroDB and IntroDB now also load for shows opened from a TMDB-based catalog; before, those episodes never asked the skip services.

improved: Deleting a download also frees its scrub preview images (skip times are kept).
fixed: Skip times from analysed episodes now work when streaming after the download was deleted.

improved: A download that does not fit waits as "Waiting for space (needs ~X GB, Y free)" and starts by itself once there is room.
fixed: Downloads no longer start when there is not enough space: every start, including Finish a series and Smart Downloads, now counts what running downloads still need and uses a typical episode size when the size is unknown.

improved: Your TheIntroDB submissions: grouped by show with poster, a card per episode, coloured status and totals. Pull down to refresh, tap to open the show.

Finish a series: pinning starts right away on the episodes after the last one you watched, as many as your Smart Downloads episode count, and says what it is doing next to the chip on the show page. Unpinning stops new downloads; ones already running keep going.
Download Season: tap a queued episode to unqueue it.
fixed: Download Season: queued episodes line up with the others and can be tapped.
Keep free space: the note no longer covers the button, and the button shows Apply or Done.
TheIntroDB import in Playback settings shows the current result instead of an old error.

improved: Finish a series: pin or unpin it from the hold menu on Home cards and with the Finish this series chip on a show's page. Pinned cards show a flag.
Keep free space: pick a size, see what would be removed, then tap Apply.
Download Season: tick unaired episodes to queue them. They download once they air.
Up next tonight shows picks right away (your last time, or 1h).
Your submissions and Copy share link are at the top of the player's flag sheet. All your submissions: Settings, Playback.
Opening a skip mark link asks before importing.
Spoiler blur also covers Download Season, Up next tonight, Finish a series, episode titles and the player episode list. Both blur switches are together in Settings, Detail Page.
fixed: TheIntroDB import and submit work again (TheIntroDB API v4).
Queued episodes now download even when auto-play is set to manual.
Search fields put the keyboard away on Search, scroll or a tap outside.

new: Up next tonight on Home: pick 30m, 1h, 1h30 or 2h and see what fits, Finish a series goals first.
Finish a series goal: pin a show in the hold menu and its next 2 episodes stay downloaded.
Keep free space: watched downloads are deleted oldest first when space runs low (off by default).
Download Season: queue episodes that haven't aired yet, or fill the next episodes up to 5, 10, 20 or 50 GB.
Continue Watching items untouched for 60 days move to a Paused row on Home; tap one to bring it back.
Mark watched up to here, in an episode's hold menu.
Per-show auto-skip (Default, Always, Never) in the Continue Watching hold menu.
Search and sort (name, size, date) in Downloads.
Downloads health check: damaged or cut-off files get a Re-download button.
Sleep timer in the speed menu: 15, 30 or 60 minutes or end of episode, with a soft fade out.
Swipe up in the player for the episode list.
Watch credits on the next-episode card.
This week in your watch stats: hours watched, series finished and time saved by skipping.
An actor's other titles show In library, Watching or Downloaded.
Share a skip mark as a link; opening it on another device imports the mark.
Your TheIntroDB submissions for the title, with their status, in the skip mark dialog.
improved: Smart Downloads: Only on Wi-Fi switch and Pause downloads while watching.
The playback speed you pick is remembered per show; hold-to-speed never is.
Spoiler blur also hides the descriptions of unwatched episodes.

new: Search the cast on a title's details by actor or character name.
Storage lists failed or incomplete downloads and deletes them in one go.
improved: Smart Downloads only queue episodes that fit and say "No space for the next episode" when nothing does.
Clean up leftovers also finds files in the default downloads folder and data left behind by background downloads.
fixed: Space from deleted downloads comes back right away instead of after a restart.
Deleting a download checks the file is really gone, and retries later if it isn't.
Deleted or restarted background downloads no longer leave gigabytes in the system cache.

improved: Finish a series cards have the same hold menu as Continue Watching.
Finish a series cards show the show name above the time left, without cutting text off.
Clean up leftovers is always on the storage card, greyed out when there's nothing to clean.

new: A Finish a series row on Home: started shows, shortest to finish first, with the time left.
Clean up leftovers in Storage removes files no download owns.
improved: Downloading from Home, details or episode rows opens the download card as a sheet right there.
The storage card updates right after a delete or a finished download.
Storage matches iOS Settings: same units, iOS free space, and the app total split by type.
Each download keeps its subtitles in its own folder, removed with the download.
Continue Watching is back in the order you watched.
fixed: "Not enough space" no longer stops downloads that fit, and says how much is needed.
Retry on a download that stopped for space checks again and resumes it.

new: Pick the quality on the auto-picked source (4K, 1080p, 720p, 480p), each with its size.
Download Season has one quality choice for the whole season.

improved: Download sources show quality and size, like 1080p · 2.3 GB, and Download Season shows the total.
Auto-pick shows "Picking…" and then the picked source on every download button.
Download quality in Downloads settings is used by Smart Downloads and auto-pick.
Smart Downloads start the next episode while you watch, a few minutes before the credits.
fixed: Hold for 2x speed never gets stuck at 2x after a switch, reload or cancelled hold.

new: Download from the hold menu on Continue Watching and Next Up cards.
Watch Party: watch in sync with friends and share invites as links (experimental).
MDBList dynamic and liked lists in the library.
improved: Updated to the latest upstream Nuvio (0.6.1), with better picture-in-picture and new translations.
Skips and seeking follow the Watch Party's rules, and auto-play waits for the party.

fixed: Tapping Good or Wrong after a skip no longer brings up the analysis prompt.

improved: Downloading one episode or movie picks its source automatically when auto-pick is on.
The Good / Wrong prompt shows a few seconds after the skip lands, with Rewind 5s on Wrong.
fixed: Download Season no longer selects episodes that haven't aired; they show their air date.
Skip Intro shows exactly when the intro starts, with its start and end times.

improved: Downloaded episodes show where their skip times come from.
fixed: Download Season with auto-pick picks a source instead of opening the full list.

new: What's new loads the latest notes online, cached for offline use.
fixed: The SideStore source carries the full release notes again.

new: After you tap Skip, a small Good / Wrong prompt shows for a few seconds. Good saves it, Wrong lets you nudge the start and end. Both are sent to TheIntroDB when submitting is on. Turn it off in Settings > Playback > Ask after Skip.
Your marks teach the on-device detector: an intro or credits you mark or confirm on a downloaded episode is matched against the rest of the season, also episodes where nothing was found before.
improved: Your own marks always win over online and on-device times for that episode, streamed or downloaded.
Times you send with Submit Timestamps are kept on the phone too.
Skip settings show how the TheIntroDB import went: how many of your submissions came in and when, or why the key was refused.
The Skip button shows where its times came from: You, TheIntroDB (yours), TheIntroDB, or On-device.
Re-analyze one episode, a season or a whole show: long-press a downloaded episode or show, or use the refresh button on a season or in Storage. Your own skip marks are kept.

Playback comes first: while you watch, one download runs at a time and on-device analysis runs slowly in the background. If the player buffers, both wait until playback is smooth again. Full speed returns when the player closes or after 2 minutes paused.

Playing a downloaded episode that isn't fully analysed asks (without stopping playback): Play now, Finish first (with a progress bar, then plays), or Finish in background. Skip times found while you watch are used straight away. Pick a default with Don't ask again, or in Playback settings.
Downloads shows speed and time left for each running episode, and for the whole season on its group row, using the same estimate as the Live Activity.
Downloads shows what you have watched: a check on watched episodes and movies, a progress bar on ones you are part-way through, and an Unwatched only filter inside a show.

Download Season with auto-pick on: the source list stays folded while it picks; each episode shows the source it will use, with Change source for alternatives. Choose myself opens the full list, and it opens by itself if auto-pick finds nothing.
Download Season: pick the episodes first (or the whole season), then sources are searched only for those. Downloaded and watched episodes start unticked.
The download Live Activity has its own StandBy layout: dark, large title, thick bar and time left, readable under the red night tint.
Your earlier TheIntroDB submissions are brought onto the phone when you play that show, and teach the detector too.
fixed: Skip Recap shows while you are inside a recap, even when the intro's early Skip button would overlap it.
Submit Timestamps: each segment type fills in its own known times (or stays empty), and what you type for one type is kept when you switch to another.
Tapping the download Live Activity no longer stacks another Downloads screen each time; it goes back to the one already open.

On-device analysis picks up again by itself after playback, after the background task, when the charger goes in, and retries a failed file a little later. Episodes no longer sit at "partly analysed, queued" until Analyse now is tapped.
A downloaded file that got stuck buffering (for example right after jumping to the resume point) is seeked again after 5 seconds and reopened if it is still stuck.
Episode cards: the watched check and the download badge no longer overlap at the top right.
Morphed tab bar: after it expands from the small Home button, tapping Search, Library or Profile works again instead of doing nothing until it collapses.
A tab tapped while the app is still getting ready now opens as soon as it can instead of being ignored.

new: Smart downloads: watch an episode and the next one or two download by themselves, on Wi-Fi.
Skip Recap button on downloaded shows, found from the audio of other episodes.
Scrub previews for downloads, made on the phone, so seeking shows real frames offline.
Offline home: with no network, Home shows what you have downloaded first.
Watch stats on your profile: hours, streaks, top shows and a yearly recap.
Pick the download quality and see the size before downloading.
This What's new screen. Find it again in Settings > About.
improved: Posters and artwork of downloads are kept on the phone, so they show offline.
Smart downloads can wait until the phone is charging.
fixed: Watched downloads are no longer deleted early; they go only once you reach the credits or the last two minutes and then close the player or start the next episode.
Smart downloads now start near the end of an episode, not halfway through.
Picture in Picture works again, from the player button and automatically when you leave the app.
Offline home redesigned with posters, episode counts and Continue watching, and it no longer shows when only Nuvio's servers are unreachable.
Watch stats: better contrast, a labelled 7-day chart, correct plurals, and one watched day counts as a streak.
Stray backslashes before apostrophes in new text are gone.
The season header in Downloads no longer sits behind the Back button.
Analysis shows "No recap found" instead of asking for another episode when other episodes are already analysed.

new: Up to date with Nuvio 0.5.10.
Episode search, go-to and sort on the show page, with a sticky bar.
Mini player and incognito mode in playback settings.
Automatic Picture in Picture on iOS.
EPG guide for Live TV.
WeTrakr and AniList tracking.
Biometric lock for profiles.
New full-bleed home hero and new tab bar.
improved: On-device analysis of downloads: subtitle sync and season intro and credits detection.
Media servers: libraries that mix movies and shows.
Smoother hero swipe on Home.
fixed: Next-episode card timing.
Downloads pausing themselves in the player.
Subtitle encodings in AutoSync.
Dismissed shows coming back after marking episodes watched.

new: Download the episode or movie you are watching from the player.
Switch to the finished download while watching. On by default.
improved: The player moves to a partial download when it is far enough ahead, and back to the stream if needed.
fixed: Downloads with expired links (HTTP 400, 403, 410) now refresh the link.
The Live Activity ends when a download fails.
Delete after watch never deletes during playback, and reads its setting correctly.
The Home hero no longer stops between two slides.
